cat <<EOF > tests/test_security_scopes_propagation.py
from typing import List
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Security
from fastapi.security import SecurityScopes
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

app = FastAPI()

def get_scopes(scopes: SecurityScopes):
    return scopes.scopes

def get_user(required_scopes: SecurityScopes, scopes_from_dep: List[str] = Depends(get_scopes)):
    return {"user": "john", "scopes": required_scopes.scopes, "scopes_from_dep": scopes_from_dep}

@app.get("/test")
def read_test(user=Security(get_user, scopes=["foo", "bar"])):
    return user

client = TestClient(app)

def test_security_scopes_propagation():
    response = client.get("/test")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["scopes"] == ["foo", "bar"]
    assert data["scopes_from_dep"] == ["foo", "bar"]

EOF
pytest tests/test_security_scopes_propagation.py
